text: Delete the bundled products feature (free Tracely + Lookout workspaces: listener, jobs, SSO, entitlements API, LookoutBundleProvisioner, config). It is off by default and its qualifying plan (Business-yearly) no longer exists. planTierLabel's 'Trial' becomes 'Free' since no external contract reads it. The app's own lookout/tracing debug tooling is NOT part of this and stays.
